title: Sabr always comes with salah
statement: Quran mein sabr hamesha salah ke saath aata hai
note: The claim the workbench was built to answer. Expect it to be refuted — and to see exactly which ayat refute it.

title: Taqwa is mostly a Makkan theme
statement: Taqwa aksar makki surahon mein aata hai

title: Iman and amal are always mentioned together
statement: Iman hamesha amal ke saath aata hai

title: Zakah never appears without salah
statement: Zakah kabhi salah ke bagher nahi aati
note: Phrased as a 'never' claim so the engine reports co-occurrences as violations.

title: Knowledge and guidance cluster in the same ayat
statement: ilm mostly appears with hidayah in the same ayah

title: Justice is a Madani concern
statement: adl mostly appears in madani surahs
